THIS IS THE SECOND BUSHEL GENERATION — the payload nests under `data` in snake_case and the location key is `bushel_location_id`, not `id`; lib/adapters/bushel.mjs branches on the body, not the URL. ROUNDING: floor-cent explained ALL 10 rows. Residuals -0.5c, -0.25c, 0c. Measured on ONE trading day — a mode that is wrong costs a REFUSAL and never a wrong price, because the identity guard is what enforces it, so this is safe to read now and worth re-checking on a second day's prices. STATE came from the company's own website, which says it is "situated in Michigan's thumb" — the STATE is theirs, the TOWN is not published there and is left unset rather than guessed, not from the payload — Bushel's location object carries a name and an id and no address. The crop names carry a marketing year ("Corn 2025"); matchBand is a substring test so each still lands on its own band. The page is a grower portal with a login, and the board is published ABOVE it — this reads only what an unauthenticated visitor is shown, holding no credential.
